points.K5: 柜型不同，规程自定并验证
points.K7: 专用废物桶，吸头算锐器
points.K15: 三分之二满就封口送走
points.S4: 会产生气溶胶的操作要进柜

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台刚检测完的生物安全柜旁，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a freshly tested biological safety cabinet and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜，今天按步骤操作一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸手比划柜内向下的气流
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot traces a downward airflow arrow inside the cabinet with its paw.
shots.narration: 每一步都有讲究。

shots.scene: 小研抱着一大堆盒子和一台小混匀器走到安全柜前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries a pile of boxes and a small vortex mixer to a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 小研赶着做实验，抱来一大堆东西。

shots.scene: 柜内堆满盒子，小研手臂快速进进出出
shots.prompt_en: Boxes crowd the cabinet work surface while the female graduate student moves her arms in and out quickly.
shots.narration: 柜里塞得满满，手臂来回猛伸。

shots.scene: 老李停下手里的检测仪，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lowers his handheld meter and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 刚检测完柜子的老李看不下去了。

shots.scene: 老李和小研并肩站在柜前，老李拿着空白操作卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the female graduate student stand side by side at the cabinet; he holds a blank instruction card.
shots.narration: 老李说：咱们一步一步来。

shots.scene: 一排防护措施图标，安全柜图标被放大并发光
shots.prompt_en: A row of protection icons; the biological safety cabinet icon enlarges and glows. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜，是一道关键的工程控制。

shots.scene: 安全柜图标挡在微生物图标和人形之间
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon stands between a microbe icon and a person icon like a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 靠设备，把风险挡在柜里。

shots.scene: 柜内剖面：下降气流把样品罩住，前方吸入气流挡住外面
shots.prompt_en: A side cutaway of the cabinet: downward clean air covers the samples while inflow air at the front blocks the outside. No people.
shots.narration: 它一边护着操作的人，

shots.scene: 样品管周围出现干净的光圈
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube surrounded by a clean glowing ring, with dust icons kept outside. No people.
shots.narration: 一边护着样品不被外界污染。

shots.scene: 老李翻开空白规程本，一页页对照柜子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer flips through a blank procedure booklet while pointing at the cabinet.
shots.narration: 柜子再好，也要照规程用。

shots.scene: 齿轮图标（设备）和文件图标（规程）咬合在一起
shots.prompt_en: A gear icon for equipment and a document icon for procedures interlock and turn together. No people.
shots.narration: 设备加规程，安全才完整。

shots.scene: 检测人员（老李）测量柜口风速，柜上挂空白合格标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer measures airflow at the cabinet opening; a blank certification tag hangs on the side.
shots.narration: 每台柜子都要定期检测认证，

shots.scene: 日历图标和合格标签，标签打勾
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to a blank certification tag with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 按国家标准和监管要求来。

shots.scene: 标签过期，柜前挂停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet with an expired blank tag and a blank do-not-use hanging sign. No people.
shots.narration: 过了有效期，先停用。

shots.section_title: 柜型不同，规程自定并验证
shots.scene: 三台外形不同的安全柜排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Three biological safety cabinets of different designs stand in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 各厂家的柜子，用法不一样。
overlay: 柜型不同，规程自定并验证

shots.section_title: 柜型不同，规程自定并验证
shots.scene: 老李和小研对照柜子写空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the female graduate student write a blank procedure while looking at the cabinet.
shots.narration: 要结合自己的柜子编规程，

shots.section_title: 柜型不同，规程自定并验证
shots.scene: 规程旁边的试运行图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure with a trial-run icon and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 试过、验证过，再正式用。

shots.scene: 小研把多余盒子拿出柜外，只留几样
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes extra boxes out of the cabinet and keeps only a few items inside.
shots.narration: 台面上的东西，先摆好。

shots.scene: 俯视图：左边移液器，中间吸头和样品，右边废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A top view of the work surface: pipettes on the left, a tip box and a sample bottle in the middle, a waste bin on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 移液器、吸头、样品、废物桶，依次排开。

shots.scene: 顺畅的流程曲线连接各物品
shots.prompt_en: A smooth flowing line linking all the items on the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 摆得顺，做起来才顺。

shots.section_title: 专用废物桶，吸头算锐器
shots.scene: 小研打开带生物危害标志的黄色废物桶盖子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the lid of a yellow waste bin with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 这个桶，专门装有害废物和锐器。
overlay: 专用废物桶，吸头算锐器

shots.section_title: 专用废物桶，吸头算锐器
shots.scene: 吸头图标旁边出现锐器标志
shots.prompt_en: A pipette tip icon next to a sharps warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 在柜里，用过的吸头当锐器处理。

shots.scene: 废物桶剖面，底部四分之一画着液面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the waste bin with liquid filling the bottom quarter. No people.
shots.narration: 开工前，桶里先加一部分消毒液。

shots.scene: 消毒液瓶空白标签，旁边规程本和风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle with a blank label beside a blank procedure booklet and an assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 用什么消毒液，按评估和规程定。

shots.scene: 酒精瓶加火焰警示，打问号
shots.prompt_en: An alcohol bottle icon with a flame warning and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 酒精易燃易挥发，不宜当浸泡液。

shots.scene: 台面上方一条从左到右的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A long arrow running from left to right above the cabinet work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 操作顺序，从左到右。

shots.scene: 左手惯用的人形，箭头方向反过来
shots.prompt_en: A left-handed person icon with the arrow reversed from right to left. No people.
shots.narration: 惯用左手的，可以反过来摆。

shots.scene: 小研取移液器、装吸头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a pipette and presses on a tip.
shots.narration: 取移液器，装吸头，调体积，

shots.scene: 小研吸取样品，加到孔板里
shots.prompt_en: She draws liquid from the sample bottle and dispenses it into a plate.
shots.narration: 吸样、加样，

shots.scene: 吸头弹进废物桶
shots.prompt_en: She ejects the used tip into the waste bin on the right.
shots.narration: 吸头顺手丢进右边的桶。

shots.scene: 交叉的手臂图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of arms crossing back and forth over open samples, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手不来回交叉，污染就少。

shots.scene: 台面中部到后部画出绿色区域
shots.prompt_en: A green zone highlighted across the middle and back of the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 下降气流罩着的地方，才受保护。

shots.scene: 小研双手在绿色区域内操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with both hands inside the green zone, away from the front opening.
shots.narration: 操作就在这块区域里做。

shots.scene: 手伸到前窗口边的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of hands working right at the front opening edge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别贴着前窗口干活。

shots.scene: 手臂猛地抽出，气流被打乱成旋涡
shots.prompt_en: A hand jerking out of the cabinet with swirling broken airflow arrows, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手臂猛进猛出，气流就乱了。

shots.scene: 小研手臂缓慢平稳地伸进去
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly and steadily slides her arms into the cabinet.
shots.narration: 进出要慢，动作要稳。

shots.scene: 柜前有人快步走过，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person rushing past the cabinet front, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜前也别来回快走。

shots.scene: 本生灯放在柜内，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A gas burner flame inside a biological safety cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里不能点火。

shots.scene: 火焰上方热气流往上翻，冲乱下降气流
shots.prompt_en: Hot air rising above a flame icon and breaking the straight downward airflow. No people.
shots.narration: 火焰的热气流，会冲乱保护气流。

shots.scene: 无菌接种环（一次性）图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A disposable sterile loop icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 需要无菌，可以改用一次性耗材。

shots.scene: 离心机在柜内，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge inside a biological safety cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机也不放进柜里运行。

shots.scene: 离心机电机风扇吹出乱流
shots.prompt_en: Air arrows blowing out from a centrifuge motor fan and disturbing the cabinet airflow. No people.
shots.narration: 它的电机风扇，会打乱柜内气流。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套从里向外擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears gloves and wipes the work surface from back to front.
shots.narration: 开工前，用指定消毒剂擦一遍。

shots.scene: 收工后擦拭物品外表面再拿出
shots.prompt_en: After work she wipes the outside of the sample box before taking it out.
shots.narration: 收工后，用同样的消毒剂再擦。

shots.scene: 紫外灯图标较小，擦拭图标较大
shots.prompt_en: A small ultraviolet lamp icon next to a larger wiping-with-disinfectant icon. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外灯只能辅助，擦拭才是主力。

shots.section_title: 三分之二满就封口送走
shots.scene: 废物桶上画三分之二高度的虚线
shots.prompt_en: A waste bin with a dashed line at two thirds of its height. No people.
shots.narration: 废物桶到三分之二，就要封口。
overlay: 三分之二满就封口送走

shots.section_title: 三分之二满就封口送走
shots.scene: 小研盖紧桶盖、外面消毒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student seals the waste bin lid and wipes the outside with disinfectant.
shots.narration: 盖紧，外表面消毒。

shots.section_title: 三分之二满就封口送走
shots.scene: 废物桶被送往指定点，箭头分向高压灭菌器或焚烧图标
shots.prompt_en: The sealed bin goes to a designated area; arrows point to an autoclave icon or an incinerator icon.
shots.narration: 送到指定地点，灭菌或焚烧，二选其一。

shots.scene: 王老师翻看空白的国家标准和学校制度
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank national standard and a blank university rule booklet.
shots.narration: 编规程，要对照国家和学校的要求。

shots.scene: 规程本上盖上审核印章
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure booklet receives an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 审核通过，再发给大家。

shots.scene: 柜内堆满盒子、试剂瓶，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet crammed with boxes and bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子不是储物柜。

shots.scene: 堆积物挡住后部排风缝的剖面图
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway showing piled items blocking the rear exhaust slot and bending the airflow. No people.
shots.narration: 东西太多，会挡住气流通道。

shots.scene: 台面上只剩几样必需品，整洁
shots.prompt_en: A tidy work surface with only a few necessary items. No people.
shots.narration: 只放这次要用的，用完拿走。

shots.scene: 小研开工前把东西一次带齐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank list and gathers everything she needs before starting.
shots.narration: 开工前一次带齐，少进少出。

shots.scene: 工作结束，小研手离开柜子，风机图标仍在转
shots.prompt_en: Work is finished; the female graduate student steps back while the cabinet fan icon keeps spinning.
shots.narration: 收工了，别急着关风机。

shots.scene: 计时器图标和柜内气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A timer icon next to airflow arrows clearing the cabinet interior. No people.
shots.narration: 让它再运行一会儿，把柜里空气换净。

shots.scene: 前窗关到规定位置，再关电源
shots.prompt_en: The front sash lowered to its closed position, then the power switch icon turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 具体时间看规程，再关窗关机。

shots.scene: 三种柜子图标并排，防护范围用盾牌数量表示
shots.prompt_en: Three cabinet icons side by side with different numbers of shield icons above them. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜分好几种。

shots.scene: 每种柜子下方标出保护对象图标：人、样品、环境
shots.prompt_en: Under each cabinet icon, small icons show what it protects: a person, a sample, the environment. No people.
shots.narration: 能护什么，各不相同。

shots.scene: 王老师对照空白风险评估表挑选柜子
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator compares a blank risk assessment form with cabinet icons on a board.
shots.narration: 用哪种柜，由风险评估定。

shots.scene: 小研询问老李，老李点头指向合适的柜子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student asks the facility engineer, who nods and points to the right cabinet.
shots.narration: 拿不准，先问老师再用。

shots.section_title: 会产生气溶胶的操作要进柜
shots.scene: 加样、混匀、开盖、研磨四个图标，周围有细小雾点
shots.prompt_en: Icons of pipetting, mixing, opening a tube and grinding, each surrounded by tiny mist dots. No people.
shots.narration: 很多操作会产生看不见的气溶胶。
overlay: 会产生气溶胶的操作要进柜

shots.section_title: 会产生气溶胶的操作要进柜
shots.scene: 这些图标被箭头送进安全柜
shots.prompt_en: Arrows carry those activity icons into a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 处理有感染性的材料，这些都要进柜做。

shots.section_title: 会产生气溶胶的操作要进柜
shots.scene: 混匀器放在柜内中后部，盖好管盖
shots.prompt_en: A small vortex mixer placed in the middle back of the cabinet next to closed tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 小设备进柜前先评估，管盖要盖紧。

shots.section_title: 会产生气溶胶的操作要进柜
shots.scene: 在开放台面上开管的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of opening a sample tube on an open bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别在开放台面上图省事。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在柜前，身边浮现规程本、合格标签、废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands before the cabinet beside icons of a procedure booklet, a certification tag and a waste bin.
shots.narration: 照规程用，定期检测，桶里先加消毒液。

shots.scene: 从左到右的箭头和绿色工作区
shots.prompt_en: A left-to-right arrow above a green work zone. No people.
shots.narration: 从左到右，在保护区里稳稳地做。

shots.scene: 打叉的火焰和离心机
shots.prompt_en: A crossed-out flame icon and a crossed-out centrifuge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不点火，不放离心机。

shots.scene: 擦拭图标和三分之二虚线的废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A wiping icon next to a waste bin with a two-thirds dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 前后消毒，桶满三分之二就封口。

shots.scene: 整洁的台面、计时器、柜型盾牌、雾点图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tidy work surface, a timer, cabinet shields and mist dots going into a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 少放东西，收工再运行，气溶胶进柜。

shots.scene: 欣欣、小研和老李站在整洁的安全柜前一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the facility engineer stand at a tidy biological safety cabinet and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 一步一步做对，柜子才护得住你，再见！
